concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-mirakl-onboard-sellers]] — 2026-09-15 Mirakl seller/shop legal-entity onboarding, HOP/security/KYC status sync and conditional bank-data mapping; statuses and emails are not seller payout or merchant-of-record proof.
warnings: Multiple currency shops are separate legal entities in this source; do not merge their onboarding status.
HOP-entered IBAN can yield dummy Mirakl Bank name/BIC fields; neither HOP submission nor status email establishes bank verification or payout eligibility.
